name: Hard Dish
tagline: A rigid 3-compartment serving dish in four colorways, modeled in 3D from the supplied product photos. Verified LIMEX composition data is in progress.
description: A moulded 3-compartment serving dish with two small pockets and one large basin, a rolled rim and a matte moulded-grain finish, produced in navy blue, off white, coral orange and mint green colorways. The interactive 3D model shows all four variants side by side and is photo-matched to the supplied reference photography, including the tapered pockets, underside support pads and feet. Verified LIMEX composition and supplier spec data for this product are in progress - no figures are published until confirmed.
